description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and callback types for Intel ADSP IPC (Inter-Processor Communication) within the Zephyr RTOS environment. It includes function prototypes for setting message and done handlers, initializing the IPC device, and sending messages, as well as callback type definitions and configuration structures.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_set_message_handler
methods.description: Registers a callback function to handle incoming IPC messages.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_set_done_handler
methods.description: Registers a callback function to handle IPC message completion notifications.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPC device, must be called before other operations.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_complete
methods.description: Marks the current message as complete, signaling to the other side.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_is_complete
methods.description: Checks if the current message has been completed.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_send_message
methods.description: Sends an IPC message with specified data.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_send_message_sync
methods.description: Sends an IPC message and blocks until completion or timeout.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_send_message_emergency
methods.description: Sends an emergency IPC message, waiting until it can be sent.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_set_resume_handler
methods.description: Registers a callback to resume the device from suspension.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_set_suspend_handler
methods.description: Registers a callback to suspend the device.
